campaign: safe-c33 shared-contract establishment: re-adjudication of the 12 X509_VERIFY_POLICY rows blocked or reopened by B54
subphase: B55 re-adjudicates exactly the 11 rows B54 marked BLOCKED (v2i_crld, v2i_idp, v2i_aaidp, v2i_NAME_CONSTRAINTS, v2i_GENERAL_NAME_ex, v2i_GENERAL_NAME, v2i_GENERAL_NAMES, v2i_issuer_alt, v2i_subject_alt, r2i_certpol, r2i_pci) and the B51 row B54 reopened (B51-V2I-005, v2i_AUTHORITY_INFO_ACCESS). B54's single blocking fact was that X509V3_EXT_nconf* admit a NULL ctx while the section path dereferenced it. Commit bea57ea74 (B54-F1) now refuses a NULL ctx in X509V3_get_section and in do_ext_nconf's r2i arm. B55 re-reads the repaired code, enumerates every section-reaching path from each row, updates the `# Safety` contracts to the now-true NULL-or-live form, and drives a load-bearing NULL-ctx negative control. 10 rows are SAFETY_DISCHARGED. 2 rows (v2i_idp, v2i_aaidp) remain BLOCKED on an independent defect discovered by the control: the generic ASN.1 template walk forms a pointer-typed slot from inline boolean fields at non-pointer-aligned struct offsets, which aborts in the encode/free path (B55-F1). Nothing is applied and CAMPAIGN-STATUS.json / state.json are untouched.

findings.class: misaligned pointer dereference / UB in the generic ASN.1 template walk for inline primitive fields
where: src/asn1/utl.rs:452-455 (`get_field_ptr`) and :462-468 (`get_const_field_ptr`) cast `base + tt.offset` to `*mut *mut c_void` / `*mut *const c_void` without regard to the field's alignment.
src/asn1/fre.rs:218 dereferences that slot (`let value = *pval`), and src/asn1/i2d.rs:234 does the same on the encode side.

ISSUING_DIST_POINT_TT (src/x509/v3_crld.rs:664-699) has ASN1_FBOOLEAN inline int fields at offsets 12 and 28; OSSL_AA_DIST_POINT_TT (src/x509/v3_crld.rs:797-818) has ASN1_FBOOLEAN/ASN1_TBOOLEAN fields at offsets 20 and 28. The reverse template walk visits offset 28 first.
observed: X509V3_EXT_nconf_nid(NULL, NULL, NID_issuing_distribution_point, "fullname:@b55_idp_section") aborts at src/asn1/fre.rs:218 during the refusal's cleanup (ISSUING_DIST_POINT_free at src/x509/v3_crld.rs:1638).
A successful idp build with a live ctx ("onlyuser:true") aborts at src/asn1/i2d.rs:234 during encoding.
A successful aaidp build with a live ctx ("URI:http://example.com") aborts at src/asn1/i2d.rs:234 during encoding.
findings.not_caused_by: the B54-F1 guard and the B55 documentation changes; the guard is what makes the NULL-ctx refusal reach the cleanup instead of dereferencing ctx, and the cleanup is where this independent defect lives.
findings.not_fixed_here: B55 is an adjudication plus documentation/test-only changes; repairing the shared template machinery is a production change and would require a new candidate S'. Two rows stay BLOCKED until it is repaired and re-adjudicated.
findings.residual_risk: The same class reaches any item whose template contains an inline field at a non-pointer-aligned offset. A whole-tree audit of ASN1_TFLG templates against struct offsets is required; B55 only establishes that none of the other ten adjudicated rows' success paths in this table use such a field.

findings.status: unchanged by B55; the B55 controls pass non-NULL values so they do not exercise it. It is not evidence for or against these rows' NULL-ctx handling.

new_unsafe_assumptions_note: No production code was added or changed by B55; the two tests use only the crate's existing public C-ABI entries and safe stack constructors.
test_only_unsafe_added: Two #[cfg(test)] functions in src/x509/v3_conf.rs: b55_rows_still_declare_the_item_their_callbacks_produce (one unsafe item-accessor call) and b55_null_config_context_is_refused_on_every_section_path (public unsafe extern entries, OPENSSL_sk_push/OPENSSL_sk_free, and one zeroed-context temporary used only by an out-of-tree probe and not present in the final tree).
safe_callers_can_cause_ub_note: Within the 10 discharged rows, no: the NULL-ctx path returns through the refusing guard and every cleanup on that path releases only NULL-or-empty values. The 2 blocked rows are NOT claimed safe: a safe config caller can still reach the B55-F1 misalignment, so they are reported BLOCKED rather than discharged.
hidden_obligations_note: B55-F1 is an explicit, reported defect with named rows and observed aborts, not a hidden obligation. The two blocked rows are the explicit accounting for it.
